name: wet
description: Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs.

OPENROUTER_API_KEY.title: OpenRouter API key (optional)
OPENROUTER_API_KEY.description: Single default credential: serves every [models.*] provider cell that keeps the OpenRouter default base_url, plus the openrouter search backend. Per-task keys may instead live in ~/.wet/config.toml or be injected via HULL_EMBED_API_KEY / HULL_RERANK_API_KEY / HULL_CHAT_API_KEY / HULL_JEV_SCORE_API_KEY. https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys

SEARCH_BACKENDS.title: Search backend chain (optional)
SEARCH_BACKENDS.description: Ordered runtime fallback chain: searxng | tavily | brave | exa | kagi | openrouter | firecrawl | duckduckgo | startpage. Empty = embedded local SearXNG.

TAVILY_API_KEY.title: Tavily API key (optional)
TAVILY_API_KEY.description: Enables the tavily search backend. https://tavily.com

BRAVE_API_KEY.title: Brave API key (optional)
BRAVE_API_KEY.description: Enables the brave search backend. https://brave.com/search/api/

EXA_API_KEY.title: Exa API key (optional)
EXA_API_KEY.description: Enables the exa search backend. https://exa.ai

KAGI_API_KEY.title: Kagi API key (optional)
KAGI_API_KEY.description: Enables the kagi search backend. https://kagi.com/settings?p=api

FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.title: Firecrawl API key (optional)
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY.description: Enables the firecrawl search backend (keyless attempt when absent). https://firecrawl.dev

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub personal access token (optional)
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. Bumps GitHub API rate limit (60->5000 req/hr) for library docs discovery. https://github.com/settings/tokens
